name: Regions Mortgage (Regions Bank)
notes: Researched from public regions.com mortgage pages and the MyMortgage sign-in page only. MyMortgage login: Online ID + Password, "Log in", "Forgot Online ID?", "Forgot Password?", "Enroll". Manage Your Mortgage Account: MyMortgage pay online with checking account and routing number; payments and cancellations must be submitted by 10:30 p.m. CT Monday-Saturday to be effective that day; weekend/holiday submissions next business day; up to two days to appear in history. MyMortgage benefits list Set Up and Manage Auto Draft, Electronic Statements, payment history, payoff quotes. Phone 1-800-986-2462 automated 24/7 (agents Mon-Thu 7:30-8, Fri 7:30-6, Sat 8-12 CT); mail P.O. Box 70903 Charlotte; branch. Hardship 800-748-9498. eDocuments: E-Document Center tab. Auto Draft cancel notice (3 business days; online, writing, fax or phone), draft day 1st-15th and enrollment routes re-read in the Automatic Draft Form PDF linked from Mortgage Forms & Fees (documented). No fees published. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (t20 review): Automatic Draft Form read; autopay_cancel upgraded; autopay help added.

help.title: Make a mortgage payment
paragraphs: Pay any time in MyMortgage with your checking account and routing number. Payments and cancellations submitted by 10:30 p.m. CT Monday to Saturday take effect that day; weekend and holiday submissions are processed the next business day. Allow up to two days for a payment to show in your history.

By phone, call 1-800-986-2462 (automated 24/7; representatives Monday to Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 8 p.m., Friday 7:30 a.m. to 6 p.m., Saturday 8 a.m. to noon CT) with your loan number, the last five digits of your SSN and your bank details.
Mail a check or money order with your coupon to Regions Mortgage, P.O. Box 70903, Charlotte, NC 28272-0903, or pay at any Regions branch.

help.title: Mortgage eDocuments
paragraphs: To get your monthly statement, annual escrow statement and IRS documents online, log in to MyMortgage and select the E-Document Center tab.

help.title: Payment assistance
paragraphs: If you are having trouble making payments, call our Payment Hardship counselors at 800-748-9498. For other questions call Mortgage Customer Service at 800-986-2462.

help.title: Auto Draft
paragraphs: Set up Auto Draft in MyMortgage under Payments, Automatic Draft, at a Regions branch, or by faxing or mailing the Automatic Draft Form. Pick a draft day from the 1st to the 15th; bi-weekly loans draft on the due date. Drafts start with your next unbilled payment, so keep paying another way until your statement shows you are enrolled.
To cancel, tell us online, in writing, by fax or by calling 1-800-986-2462, at least three business days ahead. Drafts may stop if the loan goes into default or three drafts in a row do not settle.
